text: Every single time we changed the format, the numbers dipped for a week.
Every single time we held our nerve, they came back higher than before.
That pattern took us two years to notice.
Here is the uncomfortable part about growth on this platform.
So the, um, real problem was never the algorithm or the thumbnails.
It was that we kept abandoning ideas before they had time to work.
But the audience does not see your analytics, they see a channel that wanders.
Consistency is not posting often, it is being recognisable every time.
So what would we do differently with a brand new channel today?
We would pick one format and
We would pick one format and make thirty of them before judging anything.
We would write the title and thumbnail together before recording a single frame.
And we would read every retention graph like a letter from the viewer.
Because that is exactly what it is.
